about: Wine Fair stands (tasting-practice design §5). Hosts and producers are invented (game simplification). 'pick': 'cool-warm' chooses the vintages with the fewest and the most growing-degree days in the weather record. 'tier' 0 stands are open from the start; medals open the higher tiers.

stands.title: Burgundy 2003 · 2004 · 2005
stands.blurb: One Côte d'Or village site, three summers in a row: the 2003 heatwave and the two years after it.

host.name: Claire Garnier
host.greeting: Three summers, one slope. Taste how the weather wrote each of them.

stands.title: The 2016 frost
stands.blurb: The same vines in 2015, 2016 and 2017. One spring brought the worst frost the Côte d'Or had seen since 1985.

host.name: Luc Dumont-Rivière
host.greeting: Same vines, same cellar, three springs. One of them we will never forget.

stands.title: The Mosel ripeness ladder
stands.blurb: One slope, one vintage (2018), three pickings: Kabinett, Spätlese and Auslese. Which glass is which?

host.name: Katrin Brandt
host.greeting: We walked this slope three times that autumn. Which glass waited longest for the sun?

stands.title: Mosel: a cool year and a warm year
stands.blurb: Dry Riesling from the coolest and the warmest growing season in the weather record since 1995: {cool} and {warm}.

host.name: Jonas Kessler
host.greeting: The coldest and the warmest summers our record holds. Can you tell them apart?

stands.title: Chardonnay: steel or oak
stands.blurb: The same Côte d'Or site and vintage (2018), three cellar choices: stainless steel, old barrels and new oak.

host.name: Élise Fontaine
host.greeting: Same grapes, three cellars. The wood tells its own story.

stands.title: Napa Cabernet: a cool year and a hot year
stands.blurb: Cabernet Sauvignon from the coolest and the hottest growing season in the weather record since 1995: {cool} and {warm}.

host.name: Ana Morales
host.greeting: In Napa the sun always shows up. The question is how much.

stands.title: Mosel 2002 · 2003 · 2004
stands.blurb: Dry Riesling from one slope: the 2003 heatwave between two cooler years.

host.name: Peter Lenz
host.greeting: One of these summers we still talk about. Can you find it in the glass?

stands.title: Côte d'Or whites 2017 · 2018 · 2021
stands.blurb: Chardonnay from one site in three years. One April brought three nights of hard frost.

host.name: Marc Moreau-Bernard
host.greeting: Three springs on the same slope. One of them we spent awake in the rows.
